sections.open.label.description: Section heading in the list of the person's communities, on the Communities screen and in the Your communities switcher: the communities anyone can find and join.

sections.invited.label.description: Section heading in the list of the person's communities, on the Communities screen and in the Your communities switcher: the communities only invited people can open.

sections.solo.label.description: Section heading in the list of the person's communities, on the Communities screen and in the Your communities switcher: the projects that have no member but this person.

sections.open.noun.description: What one community anyone can find and join is called, as a singular noun naming its audience.

sections.invited.noun.description: What one community only invited people can open is called, as a singular noun naming its audience.

sections.solo.noun.description: What a project with no member but this person is called, naming its audience. It stands where "Public community" or "Private community" would.

sections.open.count_one.description: Accessible name of the number beside the Public communities section heading. {{count}} is how many of the person's communities are in that section.

sections.open.count_other.description: Accessible name of the number beside the Public communities section heading. {{count}} is how many of the person's communities are in that section.

sections.invited.count_one.description: Accessible name of the number beside the Private communities section heading. {{count}} is how many of the person's communities are in that section.

sections.invited.count_other.description: Accessible name of the number beside the Private communities section heading. {{count}} is how many of the person's communities are in that section.

sections.solo.count_one.description: Accessible name of the number beside the Just you section heading. {{count}} is how many of the person's projects have no other member. "Just you" is the section's name.

sections.solo.count_other.description: Accessible name of the number beside the Just you section heading. {{count}} is how many of the person's projects have no other member. "Just you" is the section's name.

sections.showFewer.description: Last row of a section in the list of the person's communities, once every community in it is showing: folds the section back to its first few rows.

sections.showMore_one.description: Last row of a section in the list of the person's communities: reveals the next communities in that section. {{count}} is how many this press reveals.

sections.showMore_other.description: Last row of a section in the list of the person's communities: reveals the next communities in that section. {{count}} is how many this press reveals.

list.loading.description: Accessible name of the placeholder rows on the Communities screen while the person's list of communities is loading.

list.loadError.description: Title of the error card on the Communities screen when the list of the person's communities could not be loaded. A retry button follows it.

list.empty.title.description: Title of the card on the Communities screen when the person belongs to no community. The card is a link to Discover.

list.empty.subtitle.text: Browse the directory to find a project to join.
list.empty.subtitle.description: Second line of the card on the Communities screen when the person belongs to no community. The directory is the Discover screen; a project is what a community builds.

list.join.title.description: Row under the list on the Communities screen: opens Discover, where the person can find a community to join.

list.join.subtitle.text: Find one to join in Discover.
list.join.subtitle.description: Second line of the Join a community row on the Communities screen. "One" is a community; Discover is the name of the screen and of its tab.

list.start.title.description: Row under the list on the Communities screen: opens the dialog that creates a new project and its community.

list.start.subtitle.text: Make a project for you, a group or everyone.
list.start.subtitle.description: Second line of the Start a community row on the Communities screen. The three audiences a new project can be made for: only this person, an invited group, or the public.

row.members_one.description: Quiet fact on a community's row on the Communities screen: how many people belong to that community.

row.members_other.description: Quiet fact on a community's row on the Communities screen: how many people belong to that community.

row.active.justNow.description: Quiet fact on the row of a project that is just the person's own, on the Communities screen: it was last active less than a minute ago. Lower case, it follows other text on the line.

row.active.minutes_one.description: Quiet fact on the row of a project that is just the person's own, on the Communities screen: how many minutes ago it was last active. "m" abbreviates minutes; keep it short.

row.active.minutes_other.description: Quiet fact on the row of a project that is just the person's own, on the Communities screen: how many minutes ago it was last active. "m" abbreviates minutes; keep it short.

row.active.hours_one.description: Quiet fact on the row of a project that is just the person's own, on the Communities screen: how many hours ago it was last active. "h" abbreviates hours; keep it short.

row.active.hours_other.description: Quiet fact on the row of a project that is just the person's own, on the Communities screen: how many hours ago it was last active. "h" abbreviates hours; keep it short.

row.active.days_one.description: Quiet fact on the row of a project that is just the person's own, on the Communities screen: how many days ago it was last active. "d" abbreviates days; keep it short.

row.active.days_other.description: Quiet fact on the row of a project that is just the person's own, on the Communities screen: how many days ago it was last active. "d" abbreviates days; keep it short.

row.inProgress_one.description: Status on a community's row on the Communities screen: how many changes people are working on in its project right now.

row.inProgress_other.description: Status on a community's row on the Communities screen: how many changes people are working on in its project right now.

row.toVote_one.description: Status on a community's row on the Communities screen: how many proposals and group decisions in it are waiting for this person's vote. "To vote" means still to be voted on by you.

row.toVote_other.description: Status on a community's row on the Communities screen: how many proposals and group decisions in it are waiting for this person's vote. "To vote" means still to be voted on by you.

row.unread_one.description: Accessible name of the number badge on a community's row on the Communities screen: how many unread messages its chat channel has.

row.unread_other.description: Accessible name of the number badge on a community's row on the Communities screen: how many unread messages its chat channel has.

needsYou.heading.description: Section heading at the top of the Communities screen, over the row that opens the feed of votes waiting for this person across all their projects.

needsYou.waiting_one.description: Title of the Needs you row on the Communities screen: how many votes across the person's projects they have not yet seen or cast.

needsYou.waiting_other.description: Title of the Needs you row on the Communities screen: how many votes across the person's projects they have not yet seen or cast.

needsYou.skipped_one.description: Title of the Needs you row on the Communities screen when nothing new waits: how many votes the person looked at and passed over without voting, which they can still cast.

needsYou.skipped_other.description: Title of the Needs you row on the Communities screen when nothing new waits: how many votes the person looked at and passed over without voting, which they can still cast.

needsYou.projectsMore_one.description: Second line of the Needs you row on the Communities screen: which projects the votes are owed on. {{projects}} is the first three project names, already joined as a list; {{count}} is how many further projects there are.

needsYou.projectsMore_other.description: Second line of the Needs you row on the Communities screen: which projects the votes are owed on. {{projects}} is the first three project names, already joined as a list; {{count}} is how many further projects there are.

needsYou.review.description: Verb, at the end of the Needs you row on the Communities screen: says that pressing the row opens the votes waiting for the person so they can go through them.

needsYou.back.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the back arrow over the Needs you feed on the Communities screen: returns to the list of the person's communities. Communities is the screen's name.

needsYou.over.description: Small line above the title of the Needs you feed on the Communities screen: names the screen the feed belongs to.

needsYou.title.description: Title of the page of the Communities screen that shows, one at a time, every vote waiting for this person across their projects.

reel.fallbackTitle.change.description: Stands in for the title of a proposal (a change to a project put up for a vote) in the Needs you feed when the proposal has no title.

reel.fallbackTitle.decision.description: Stands in for the title of a group decision (a vote on a project's settings, such as a rename, rather than on a code change) in the Needs you feed when it has no title.

reel.ask.change.description: Question over the Yes and No buttons of a proposal in the Needs you feed: asks whether the proposed change should be merged into the project.

reel.ask.decision.description: Question over a group decision in the Needs you feed: asks whether the decision (for example a rename of the project) should be carried out.

reel.yes.description: Vote button on a proposal in the Needs you feed of the Communities screen: votes for the change going in.

reel.no.description: Vote button on a proposal in the Needs you feed of the Communities screen: votes against the change going in.

reel.error.text: Couldn't load what is waiting on you. Each project's own Needs you page still has it.
reel.error.description: Shown in place of the Needs you feed on the Communities screen when it could not be loaded. Needs you is also the name of a tab on every project's page, which lists the same votes for that project.

reel.loading.description: Accessible name of the empty placeholder shown while the Needs you feed on the Communities screen is loading.

reel.empty.text: Nothing is waiting on your vote in any of your projects.
reel.empty.description: Shown in place of the Needs you feed on the Communities screen when no proposal or group decision is waiting for this person's vote.

reel.done.description: Button on the card at the end of the Needs you feed on the Communities screen: returns to the list of the person's communities.

reel.capped_one.text: Showing the newest {{count}}. Each project's own Needs you page has the rest.
reel.capped_one.description: Note under the Needs you feed on the Communities screen when there are more votes than it loads. {{count}} is how many it shows. Needs you is also the name of a tab on every project's page.

reel.capped_other.text: Showing the newest {{count}}. Each project's own Needs you page has the rest.
reel.capped_other.description: Note under the Needs you feed on the Communities screen when there are more votes than it loads. {{count}} is how many it shows. Needs you is also the name of a tab on every project's page.

switcher.title.description: Title of the switcher that lists every community the person belongs to, opened from the header's name or the Communities tab, for moving from one community to another.

switcher.all.name.description: First row of the Your communities switcher: leaves the single community being shown and opens the list of all of the person's communities.

switcher.all.count_one.description: Second line of the All communities row in the Your communities switcher: how many communities the person belongs to.

switcher.all.count_other.description: Second line of the All communities row in the Your communities switcher: how many communities the person belongs to.

switcher.all.every.description: Second line of the All communities row in the Your communities switcher while the list is still loading, so there is no count to show yet.

switcher.loading.description: Note in the Your communities switcher while the list of the person's communities is loading.

switcher.row.solo.description: Second line of a row in the Your communities switcher, for a project that has no member but this person.

switcher.row.invited_one.description: Second line of a row in the Your communities switcher, for a community only invited people can open. {{count}} is how many people belong to it. Keep the middle dot between the two facts.

switcher.row.invited_other.description: Second line of a row in the Your communities switcher, for a community only invited people can open. {{count}} is how many people belong to it. Keep the middle dot between the two facts.

switcher.row.open_one.description: Second line of a row in the Your communities switcher, for a community anyone can find and join. {{count}} is how many people belong to it. Keep the middle dot between the two facts.

switcher.row.open_other.description: Second line of a row in the Your communities switcher, for a community anyone can find and join. {{count}} is how many people belong to it. Keep the middle dot between the two facts.

switcher.toVote_one.description: Badge on a row of the Your communities switcher: how many proposals and group decisions in that community (or, on the All communities row, in all of them) are waiting for this person's vote.

switcher.toVote_other.description: Badge on a row of the Your communities switcher: how many proposals and group decisions in that community (or, on the All communities row, in all of them) are waiting for this person's vote.

switcher.join.description: Row at the end of the Your communities switcher: closes it and opens Discover, where the person can find a community to join.

switcher.start.description: Row at the end of the Your communities switcher: closes it and opens the dialog that creates a new project and its community.
